personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean fused with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, warm, and highly functional messaging experience that balances lightning-fast utility with elevated, cinematic details.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm for lists to avoid cramping. Touch targets must be at least 44x44. Safe areas handled precisely.

do's: Apply frosted glass to the bottom tab bar and sticky chat header when content scrolls underneath.
Use heavy blur (e.g., expo-blur with intensity 50+) backed by a 70% opacity tint of the background color (surface/surfaceInverse) for readability.
Use glass overlays for in-call control floating actions.
dont's: Do not apply glass to individual chat bubbles or standard list rows.
Avoid glass behind text inputs or dense settings forms.

screens.name: Auth Flow (Welcome, Sign Up, Login)
screens.purpose: Introduce the Ditsala premium brand identity and onboard users seamlessly.

states.error: Inline red text below input fields or a toast for network issues.

screens.layout: Welcome screen uses the 'friends_laughing' hero image with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom) ensuring the logo and 'Your Trusted Circle' tagline pop in white. Action buttons sticky at bottom. Form screens are clean, single-column, with labels above inputs and a sticky CTA.

screens.name: Chats List (Home)
screens.purpose: Scannable, dense list of recent conversations prioritizing unread messages.

states.loading: Skeleton rows mimicking avatars and text lengths.
states.empty: Illustration of friendly connection, text 'No messages yet', and a primary CTA 'Start Chat' in brandPrimary green.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with a search bar. Native list (FlatList) for conversation rows. Row: 48pt avatar left, name and relative timestamp on top line, truncated message preview and green unread badge on bottom line. A floating action button (FAB) in brandPrimary green pinned bottom-right for 'New Message'.

screens.name: Real-time Chat Screen
screens.purpose: Immersive, real-time messaging interface with multimedia support.

states.empty: Date separator 'Today', otherwise empty background waiting for first message.
states.error: Error icon next to failed message bubble; tap to retry.

screens.layout: Glass header showing contact name, online status, and call icons. Background uses 'chat_bg' (warm texture) with full edge-to-edge coverage. Chat bubbles: Outgoing (brandPrimary at 15% opacity for light mode, solid green for dark mode, or solid brandPrimary for both with white text), Incoming (surfaceSecondary). Voice notes show a waveform and playback controls. Pinned messages appear as a small banner below the header. The composer is sticky at the bottom with a frosted glass background, containing text input, emoji, attachment, and a dominant mic/send button.

screens.name: Calls List & Active Call
screens.purpose: View call history and manage active voice/video sessions.

states.empty: Message 'No recent calls' with CTA 'Start a Call'.

screens.layout: List view similar to chats, using angled arrows (green for incoming, grey for outgoing, red for missed). Active Call screen is a full-bleed dark overlay (surfaceInverse) with a large avatar/video feed, and a floating glass pill at the bottom containing mute, speaker, video, and end call (red) buttons.

screens.name: Contacts & Profile
screens.layout: Contacts: A clean list with alphabetical section headers. Profile: Large cover banner (using surfaceInverse gradient), prominent 100pt avatar, display name, and elevated settings rows (tinted icon containers on the left, label, right chevron).

screens.name: VIP Premium Translation
screens.purpose: Upsell the core cross-language translation feature.
screens.layout: Cinematic upsell screen. Background is the 'vip_hero' gold abstract image with a heavy dark scrim. A glowing 3D crown or badge icon. Large typography emphasizing 'Ditsala VIP: Speak Every Language'. A sticky, full-width gold (brandSecondary) button 'Upgrade Now' at the bottom.

hero_welcome.alt: Modern diverse African friends laughing portrait

chat_bg.alt: Subtle abstract warm texture for chat background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's requested palette: Deep Navy (#0B1E5B) for brand base and headers, Fresh Green (#5FB325) for primary actions/unread badges, and Warm Gold (#F5A623) for VIP features.

DARK MODE MAPPING: In dark mode, 'surface' becomes very dark navy (e.g., #050B20), 'surfaceSecondary' becomes #0B1E5B (base brand color). Text flips to white. Maintain Green and Gold accents as they are highly visible on dark backgrounds.

CHAT BUBBLES: Outgoing bubbles should be 'brandPrimary' (#5FB325) with white text, or a light tint of it (#EAF5E4) with dark text in light mode. Incoming bubbles should be 'surfaceSecondary'. Use a subtle border radius of 'md' on bubbles, with one sharp corner indicating direction (e.g., bottom-right sharp for outgoing).
VOICE NOTES: Research indicates premium voice note bubbles need an audio waveform (even a static SVG representation), duration, and a play icon. Ensure they split gracefully if multiple are sent.
SCRIM PATTERN: The Welcome screen hero image and VIP screen hero image MUST have a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to ensure text legibility.
GLASS SURFACES: Use glassmorphism on the bottom tabs, the chat screen header, and the chat composer bar. This keeps the warm chat background visible while maintaining UI structure.
EMPTY STATES: Ensure all list screens (Chats, Calls, Contacts) have full-screen flex:1 empty states with an illustration or large icon, descriptive text, and a primary action button.
INTERACTIONS: Wire haptics directly into the chat Send button, tab presses, and long-press message context menus to ensure tactile feedback.
